about:
Chicago Medical Engineering is based in Elmhurst, Illinois. The company was founded in 2019 by a team of engineers who recognized the importance of calibrated, high-performing medical imaging equipment. They set out to fill a market gap for reliable, turnkey solutions in capital medical equipment.

The company supplies pre-owned medical imaging systems and parts through a catalog of more than 1,190 items across 16 equipment categories, including CT scanners, MRI systems, cath/angio labs, portable X-ray units, ultrasound transducers, digital mammography units, and linear accelerators. In addition to sales and leasing, Chicago Medical Engineering provides comprehensive service and maintenance for imaging and radiation therapy equipment. Its engineers perform preventive maintenance, emergency repairs, calibration, compliance assurance, installation, de-installation, and refurbishment. The firm also offers project coordination, asset management, and regulatory documentation support.

Customers include hospitals, outpatient diagnostic centers, radiation therapy clinics, and radiology departments worldwide. The company cites work with radiation oncology directors, healthcare procurement executives, and lead biomedical engineers who rely on its technical data accuracy and responsive support for complex machinery such as Varian TrueBeam linear accelerators.

Chicago Medical Engineering was started to address the need for calibrated medical equipment that delivers consistent results. The company emphasizes end-to-end project coordination, a global network of vendor-certified engineers (including Varian, GE, Siemens, Philips, Toshiba, and Medtronic), and adherence to standards such as The Joint Commission, DNV Healthcare, and NFPA 99. The team’s combined 80 years of experience underpins its approach to reducing downtime and extending asset lifecycles.
